# Global membership and loyalty platform

- Requirement ID: REQ-LOY-001
- Sponsor: Loyalty
- Date: 2026-11-12
- Regions: EU, US, APAC

## Background

Members earn and redeem loyalty points across web, mobile and point-of-sale channels. The current platform runs in one region and cannot meet data residency rules in new markets. This document describes what the new platform must do; it does not prescribe a design.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Related NFRs |
|---|---|
| Member enrolment and identity | Data residency; PII encryption at rest and in transit |
| Points accrual | Availability; p99 latency; Peak accrual throughput; Ledger recovery point (RPO) |
| Points redemption | p99 latency; Idempotent redemption |
| Promotions | Regional scale-out |
| Member notifications | PII encryption at rest and in transit |
| Audit and admin | Audit trail for ledger and admin actions |

## Non-functional requirements

| NFR | Priority | Target |
|---|---|---|
| Availability | Must | 99.95% |
| p99 latency | Must | 300 ms |
| Peak accrual throughput | Must | 2000 accruals/s |
| Ledger recovery point (RPO) | Must | 0 s |
| Data residency | Must | EU, US, APAC |
| PII encryption at rest and in transit | Must | Required |
| Audit trail for ledger and admin actions | Must | Required |
| Idempotent redemption | Must | Required |
| Regional scale-out | Should | Required |
| Monthly infrastructure cost ceiling | Must | Not agreed yet |
| DR test cadence | Should | Not agreed yet |

## Open decisions

- Can points expire, and under which regional rules? (affects: Points accrual, Points redemption)
- Is cross-region redemption required at launch? (affects: Points redemption, Data residency)
